new_today_news.headline: Winter Garden receives nearly $9.6M in funding for wastewater treatment plant expansion
new_today_news.summary: Winter Garden, Florida is receiving $9.6 million in non-repayable state funding to expand its Crest Avenue Wastewater Treatment Facility. The project will increase treatment capacity from 4.75 million gallons per day to 7.5 million gallons per day to accommodate future population growth.

new_today_news.headline: Used Cooking Oil Market (2026 - 2035)
new_today_news.summary: Market report analyzing the used cooking oil industry with analysis of EPA volume mandates for 2026–2027, noting that these effectively guarantee offtake and have shifted restaurant contracts from spot arrangements to three-year fixed-margin structures. Key players include Darling Ingredients (~10–13% market share), Baker Commodities, and others.

new_today_news.headline: Major waste companies spent $1.2B on Q3 M&A, driven by GFL
new_today_news.summary: GFL Environmental's acquisition of Secure Waste Infrastructure dominated Q3 2026 M&A activity in the waste sector. WM and Republic Services also increased year-over-year M&A spending.

new_today_news.headline: Pendleton-Clemson Wastewater Treatment Plant Celebrates $64 Million Expansion
new_today_news.summary: The Pendleton-Clemson Wastewater Treatment Plant expansion was celebrated with a grand opening following groundbreaking in August 2024. The $64 million project increases plant capacity by 150%, moving from 2 million to 5 million gallons per day to serve growing communities.

recent_news.headline: Casella aims to hit 26% margin by 2029, scraps NH landfill project
recent_news.summary: Casella Waste Systems announced a "300 in 3" margin improvement plan, including layoffs and operational restructuring in the mid-Atlantic. Fuel surcharge changes and standardized fee structures were also implemented.

recent_news.headline: November 2026 Issue of Onsite Installer
recent_news.summary: Trade publication issue featuring septic industry content including business profiles, technician advancement, and life-cycle cost analysis of septic systems.

recent_news.headline: First Watch Restaurant Group, Inc. to Host Inaugural Investor Day on Thursday, November 12th to Share Strategic Growth Vision
recent_news.summary: First Watch Restaurant Group reported Q3 2026 financial results with same-restaurant sales growth of 1.0%, total revenues increased 10.7%, and 16 new system-wide restaurants opened in 11 states. The company plans to open 62 system-wide restaurants in 2026 and approximately 55 in 2027.

recent_news.headline: North Texas 2026 Holiday Grease Roundup
recent_news.summary: The 2026 Holiday Grease Roundup runs from November 1 through January 31, 2027, collecting used cooking oil and grease across North Texas with 51 drop-off stations. The program diverts 100% of collected material into renewable energy via biodiesel and biogas production.

recent_news.headline: Septic Tanker Truck Market Forecast to 2035: Growth Accelerates on Municipal Wastewater Upgrades
recent_news.summary: Market analysis forecasts growth in the septic tanker truck segment through 2035, driven by municipal wastewater infrastructure upgrades and environmental regulatory tightening.

backfill_news.headline: Austin Water Grease Trap Relief Program Is Now Live!
backfill_news.summary: Austin Water launched a Grease Trap Relief Program offering no-cost grease trap equipment and installation to qualifying small businesses and charitable feeding organizations. The program addresses FOG management and reduces risk of sanitary sewer overflows from failing grease traps.
